odteste.comando.erro.elemento: Unknown element: %s. Use nenhum, sangue, conhecimento, morte or energia.
odteste.comando.erro.estagio: Missing the Mark stage for %s (1 to 4). Only "nenhum" can skip the stage.
odteste.momento.marca.morte: Time slowed down on your skin.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.1: Nothing has looked at you. Yet.
odteste.horror.exposicao.comum.3: You are still just one of many.
odteste.horror.exposicao.baixa.1: You heard something. It heard you.
odteste.horror.exposicao.media.1: There are footsteps that match yours.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.1: Someone stands at the edge of your sight. They are still there.
odteste.horror.exposicao.alta.3: What looks back already knows your name.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.1: You are no longer the one searching.
odteste.horror.exposicao.critica.2: The door is open. On the other side, they are waiting.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.1: Feet on the ground. For now.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.2: What you see is what exists.
odteste.horror.lucidez.firme.3: Breathe. Everything is in its place.
odteste.horror.lucidez.alta.1: Something is out of place. You haven't found it yet.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.1: You no longer trust what you hear.
odteste.horror.lucidez.media.2: The door you closed is open.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.1: Your own voice whispers from across the room.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.2: You no longer know who is calling you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.baixa.3: What is real drifts away from you.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.2: There is no floor. Only what you think is there.
odteste.horror.lucidez.surto.3: You are lost and cannot find the way.
odteste.configuration.title: Od Teste
odteste.configuration.efeitos_fortes.too: Camera shake, tilt and visual hallucinations (figures, doors, blocks). SUAVE halves it; DESLIGADO leaves only vignette, sound and text.
item.odteste.rubra.objeto: A kitchen knife that grew. Its edge grew teeth.
item.odteste.rubra.poder: Wounded, it bites: every blow opens blood that builds up.
item.odteste.rubra.custo: It only wakes when your own blood is already running.
odteste.rubra.ferida: The jaw closes. The wound opens.
item.odteste.agulha_de_cerzir_carne.obje: A crochet needle wrapped in red thread. The thread never runs out.
item.odteste.agulha_de_cerzir_carne.pode: Closes wounds and stops the bleeding.
item.odteste.agulha_de_cerzir_carne.cust: Every stitch in the flesh is owed to the paranormal.
odteste.artefato.agulha.uso: The thread goes in and out. The flesh obeys.
item.odteste.dedal_dentado.objeto: A dark iron thimble. Inside, teeth.
item.odteste.dedal_dentado.poder: For a while, whoever wounds you bleeds too.
item.odteste.dedal_dentado.custo: It bites your mind and takes some of your breath until you sleep.
odteste.artefato.dedal.uso: The teeth close on your finger. Now they wait.
item.odteste.sino_de_matadouro.objeto: A butcher's brass bell. The clapper is black with dried blood. It rings without wind.
item.odteste.sino_de_matadouro.poder: Its toll enrages those at your side.
item.odteste.sino_de_matadouro.custo: It charges flesh from whoever rings it. And the paranormal listens.
odteste.artefato.sino.uso: The bell tolls. Something far away heard it too.
odteste.artefato.sino.sem_sangue: The bell is heavy. There is not enough blood to pay for the toll.
odteste.artefato.recusa.recarga: Not yet. It does not answer.
odteste.artefato.recusa.compartilhada: Your hands still shake from the last one.
odteste.artefato.recusa.sem_lucidez: Your mind cannot hold this right now.
item.odteste.materia_sangue_bruta.objeto: Thick, heavy and warm. It smells of rust and meat.
ritual.odteste.chamado_de_sangue.started: The chalk drinks the blood. Something heard.
ritual.odteste.chamado_de_sangue.conditi: The call does not take hold here.
